summary: Fixed the maxClicks API tests to consume each response body only once and avoid requiring an explicitly serialized RFC 7807 type field when the response already has a valid status and title.
rationale: The invalid-limit tests were reading a disposed response stream by deserializing the same body twice. The 410 tests also assumed the ProblemDetails type property must be serialized, although RFC 7807 permits the default about:blank type to be omitted. The helper now returns the parsed body for further assertions and checks status and title.
content: Updated `MaxClicksApiTests` to read each ProblemDetails response once, retain the parsed JSON for failure-path assertions, and validate the required status and title without requiring an optional serialized `type` field.
